blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — Police seized an unlicensed firearm and several rounds of ammunition from a motorcycle rider intercepted at a checkpoint in Lopez, Quezon, on Friday, Oct. 30. In a report on Saturday, the Police Regional Office-Calabarzon (PRO-4A) said officers manning an Undas security checkpoint flagged down a lone motorcycle rider in Barangay Bacungan on Friday morning. As the rider slowed down, police noticed a handgun tucked into his waist. The suspect allegedly sped away, prompting officers to pursue and corner him.
